title: Quick Tip: What’s Coming in Business Central – 2025 Release Wave 2
summary: Business Central 2025 Release Wave 2 (October 2025 to March 2026) introduces Copilot and AI enhancements, global localization updates for multiple countries, and improved developer tooling to increase productivity and reduce manual work.
key_points: Copilot and AI features include Sales Order Agent, chat improvements, autofill suggestions, and AI summarization
Global expansion covers UK localization extension, Czechia UI enhancements, US IRS 1099 electronic submission, and Australian Payment Times Reporting compliance
Developer experience improvements make building, testing, and deploying AL solutions more efficient

quotes.text: Microsoft is expanding Business Central to more countries and regions, with updates to local compliance and UI improvements.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the global reach expansion strategy through localization and regional compliance updates
